title: Rebound and Outlet Push
description: A rebounder secures a missed shot and immediately pushes to find the outlet pass that starts a fast break, under light simulated pressure.

content.objective: Secure the rebound with two hands and find the outlet pass quickly to start the break.
content.setup: A shot is missed on purpose near the rim; a rebounder and an outlet target wait nearby.
instructions: Secure the rebound at its highest reachable point with both hands.
Pivot the chair away from any pressure immediately after securing it.
Find the outlet pass to the wing, leading them up the floor.
Rotate the rebounder every three reps.
coachingPoints: Chin the ball above the shoulders right after the catch.
Turn the chair away from pressure before looking to pass.
Make the outlet pass sharp and on time, not a lazy lob.
commonMistakes: Bringing the ball down low where it can be knocked away.
Outletting to a spot instead of leading the receiver forward.
Reaching for the ball with one hand instead of securing it with two.
content.safety: Light contact only when simulating pressure on the rebounder.
